enchantments.tooltip: Greater Bleeding: This weapon is precisely sharp and will do an additional 5 to 40 damage to targets that are vulnerable to bleeding.

Heartseeker VI: On Critical Hit: 13 to 78 Piercing damage from weapons with a x2 Critical Multiplier, 13 to 104 Piercing damage from weapons with a x3 Critical Multiplier, and 13 to 130 Piercing damage from weapons with a x4 or greater Critical Multiplier.
Insightful Seeker +6: Provides a +6 Insight bonus to confirm critical hits, and a +6 Insight bonus to critical hit damage (before multipliers are applied).

Improved Destruction: On Hit: Your target gains a stack of Armor Destruction. (-1 penalty to Armor Class, -1% of its Fortification. 20 Second Duration. Stacks up to 15 times.) This effect may trigger once every second.
+12 Enhancement Bonus: +12 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Epic Slice 'n Dice Set: While wearing both items from the Epic Slice 'n Dice Set, you gain:+2 Quality bonus to Seeker+2 Quality bonus to Sneak AttackThey make julienne fries.
Epic The Devil's Handiwork: While wearing any five items from the Epic The Devil's Handiwork, you gain: +3 Quality bonus to all Ability stats
Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
